## ⚠️ This Repository is Archived

**Thank you for your interest in eduvia!**

However, this repository is **no longer actively maintained** as of January 30, 2026. The original development team has discontinued work on this project.

### What This Means

- ❌ **We are not accepting new issues** on this repository
- ❌ **Pull requests will not be reviewed or merged**
- ❌ **No bug fixes or feature updates** will be provided

### What You Can Do

✅ **Fork the repository** and continue development on your own
- See [FORK_GUIDE.md](../FORK_GUIDE.md) for complete setup instructions
- This project is open source under the MIT License

✅ **Create your own version** for your institution
- Adapt and customize to your needs
- Share your improvements with the community

✅ **Ask for community help**
- Search existing issues for solutions
- Join Next.js, Supabase, or web dev communities
- Check Stack Overflow for technical questions

### Resources

- **Setup Guide:** [FORK_GUIDE.md](../FORK_GUIDE.md)
- **Contributing:** [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)
- **License:** [LICENSE](../LICENSE)
